title: feat(cart): add locale selection for the empty-cart label
body:
## Summary

`web/src/emptyState.ts` now selects Spanish or English from the active locale and falls back to English for unknown locales. The export remains callable without arguments.

## Reason

English-speaking shoppers need a readable empty state instead of receiving the Spanish label.

## Validation proposed

Exercise English, Spanish, and an unknown locale; confirm the fallback text is English. Only those two languages are in scope.
